sheets.noticed: Cream paper look, a dark block of water and a dock with a post. Moody, a little different from the usual feed.
A black stick figure fades in sitting on the end of the dock. Calm, storybook voice.
Nothing moves, she just sits. Getting a bit bored, thumb hovering.
Still the same picture, but the voice says 'Then the rope' and that makes me wait a second.
'post went tight' but I can't see anything change. Hanging on only because of the words.
The rope snaps straight down into the dark water at an angle. 'Something below had...' Okay, now I'm in.
'taken hold of it'. Rope stays taut into the black. Creepy, I want to see what it is.
Silence, the picture slowly zooms in a bit. Tense, waiting for something to come up.
'She didn't move.' Same shot, still waiting.
'Neither did whatever was holding on.' Nice line, but nothing happens on screen.
Quiet, faint ripple maybe. Still hoping for a reveal.
It just ends on the same still picture. No reveal, a bit of a letdown, though the mood stuck.

remembers: A girl is sitting on a dock and the rope on the post suddenly goes tight because something under the water grabs it, and then they both just stay still. It never shows what it is.
